title: Mithras liturgy ascent through seven heavens

tellings.quote: In the Mithras liturgy found in Greek magical Papyri, an initiate employs breathing techniques, visualizations, chants, and ceremonial rituals to ascend through the seven heavens.

plain: In the Mithras Liturgy, an ancient text found among the Greek Magical Papyri, a collection of old Greek magical writings, a new initiate climbs through the seven heavens using breathing techniques, visualizations, chants and ceremonies. Michels tells this himself, as something he has read. He offers it as an old method for reaching other levels of reality through the mind.
